protocol.purpose: retrospective input-sensitivity/coverage pilot, not an operational accuracy gain
protocol.case_selection: fixed dates + first complete baseline tuple; no outcome-based selection
protocol.weather_days: Same UTC valid day and five daily variable meanings as direct.Weather; no future-day feature substitution
protocol.weather_cutoff: 00UTC of input weather day; init selected >=12h earlier and rounded BACK to midnight for daily API support; not proof of availability
protocol.fire_cutoff: benchmark uses detections through t0; its next-midnight proxy is later than the conservative weather cutoff
protocol.future_features: future_feature_harness gives day+1..3; introducing those into ML requires a new feature schema and chronological training
protocol.training: none; frozen wf_2024/wf_2025 weights and selection rules reused unchanged; existing inspected benchmarks
protocol.counterfactual: pre-May2026 IFS Cycle49R1 hindcast/unverified, explicitly refused by strict as-issued guard
protocol.baseline: Actual cached five-element tuple, missing values retained; never replaced by freshly fetched reanalysis
